_说明: 术语表。英文和产品里用的一致(liuyao-engine.js / liuyao-ai.js 的 en 字段):六亲 Resource/Peer/Output/Wealth/Pressure,用神 Subject,原神 Support,忌神 Adversary,六神 Azure Dragon 等,旺相休囚死 Thriving/Strong/Resting/Trapped/Dead,进退神 Advancing/Retreating。
check:原文里出现这些写法时,同一行的英文必须出现 needle(没写 needle 就用 en,不分大小写)。只放在六爻里没有歧义的写法。某一段里这个词是字面意思(比如「父母」指爹娘)时,在那段 quote 上写 "literal": ["父母"] 豁免,并且只豁免那一段。
aliases:Obsidian 里的别名,也用来认出一条规则提到了哪些术语。

terms.yi: 六亲之一,我克者。求财以它为用神;男占婚姻也以它为妻。
terms.def: One of the six relations: the element the Self controls. The Subject line for money questions (and the wife in a man's marriage question).

terms.yi: 六亲之一,我生者。它生妻财,所以求财时叫「财源」「福神」,是财的原神;又克官鬼,能解灾。
terms.def: One of the six relations: the element the Self generates. It generates Wealth, so in money questions it is the source of money (the Support of the Wealth line); it also controls Pressure and so relieves trouble.

terms.yi: 六亲之一,与我同类者。它克妻财,占财最忌,书上叫「劫财」「劫杀」;也主同伴、竞争者、耗费。
terms.def: One of the six relations: the same element as the Self. It controls Wealth, so it is the worst sign in a money question (the classics call it the robber of wealth); it also stands for partners, rivals and spending.

terms.yi: 六亲之一,克我者。求财时一般主阻隔、官非、盗贼;但它克兄弟,能护财;空手求财、公门求财时反而以它为主。
terms.def: One of the six relations: the element that controls the Self. In money questions it usually means obstruction, officials, lawsuits or thieves; but it controls Peer and so can protect the money, and for skill-based or official money it becomes the main line.

terms.yi: 六亲之一,生我者。它克子孙,断了财的来源,占财时叫「绝源杀」;又主辛劳、文书、契约。
terms.def: One of the six relations: the element that generates the Self. It controls Output and so cuts off the source of money (the classics call it the killer of the source); it also means toil, documents and contracts.

terms.yi: 代表问卦人自己的那一爻。
terms.def: The line that stands for the asker.

terms.yi: 代表对方(对手、交易的人、被求的人)的那一爻。
terms.def: The line that stands for the other party: the counterpart, the buyer or seller, the person being asked.

terms.yi: 世、应之间的两爻,主中间人、中保、牙人。
terms.def: The two lines between Self and Other: go-betweens, guarantors, brokers.

terms.yi: 按月卦身法取的一爻,代表所占之事的「体」。野鹤老人说它不验,只看世爻。
terms.def: A line picked by the month-body method that stands for the matter itself. The Old Man of Yehe held it unreliable and used the Self line instead.

terms.yi: 所问之事落在哪一爻,哪一爻就是用神。求财以妻财为用神。
terms.def: The line that stands for what is being asked about. For money, the Wealth line.

terms.yi: 生用神的那一类爻。求财时是子孙。
terms.def: The relation that generates the Subject. For money, Output.

terms.yi: 克用神的那一类爻。求财时是兄弟。
terms.def: The relation that controls the Subject. For money, Peer.

terms.yi: 起卦那个月的地支,定各爻的旺相休囚。
terms.def: The branch of the month in which the hexagram is cast; it sets each line's seasonal strength.

terms.yi: 起卦那一天的地支,能生克冲合各爻,也定旬空。
terms.def: The branch of the day of casting; it can generate, control, clash with or combine any line, and fixes which branches are void.

terms.yi: 当年的地支。占一年的事看它。
terms.def: The Year Lord: the branch of the current year. Used for questions covering a whole year.

terms.yi: 年、月、日、时四个当值的干支。《易隐》讲贵人时列的就是这四个:「四直之贵,年之力大如月,月之力大如日,日之力大如时」。
terms.def: The four rulers of the moment: the branches of the Year, Month, Day and Hour.

terms.yi: 太岁、月建、日辰三个当值的干支。《黄金策》旧注:「三传太岁月建日辰」;《卜筮正宗》:「三传,年月日也」。
terms.def: The Year (Tai Sui), the Month and the Day: the three rulers of the moment. Not the three transmissions of Da Liu Ren.

terms.yi: 当令为旺,受月建所生为相,都算有力。
terms.def: Thriving: the line's element rules the month. Strong: the month generates it. Both count as having force.

terms.yi: 休、囚、死都算无力。
terms.def: Resting, trapped or dead: the line has no seasonal force.

terms.yi: 起卦那一旬里轮空的两个地支。落空的爻暂时不作数,出旬或逢冲才实。
terms.def: The two branches left out of the current ten-day cycle. A void line does not count for now; it becomes real when the cycle passes or it is clashed.

terms.yi: 被月建冲的爻。
terms.def: A line clashed by the Month branch.

terms.yi: 五行的墓地(水土墓辰、木墓未、火墓戌、金墓丑)。入墓主收藏、困住,冲开墓才出。
terms.def: The tomb (storehouse) of each element: Water and Earth in Chen, Wood in Wei, Fire in Xu, Metal in Chou. Entering the tomb means being stored or shut in; it comes out when the tomb is clashed open.

terms.yi: 十二长生的第一位,主刚起步、慢慢长。
terms.def: The first of the twelve life stages: just starting, growing slowly.

terms.yi: 十二长生里最旺的一位,主正当时。
terms.def: The strongest of the twelve life stages: exactly in season.

terms.yi: 十二长生里无力的几位,主陷、尽。
terms.def: The powerless stages of the twelve-stage cycle.

terms.yi: 摇出老阴(交)、老阳(重)的爻,会变。书上说「交重」就是发动。
terms.def: A line cast as old yin (jiao) or old yang (zhong); it changes. The classics' jiaozhong simply means moving.

terms.yi: 动爻变出来的那一爻。「甲化乙」就是甲爻动,变出乙。动为事之始,变为事之终。
terms.def: The line a moving line turns into. 'A turns into B' means line A moves and becomes B. The moving line is how the matter starts; the changed line is how it ends.

terms.yi: 动爻变出来的爻反过来克它自己。
terms.def: The changed line controls the very line that moved into it.

terms.yi: 同一五行往前变(如寅化卯),主越来越盛。
terms.def: A line turns into the next branch of the same element (e.g. Yin into Mao): growing stronger.

terms.yi: 同一五行往回变(如卯化寅),主消退。
terms.def: A line turns back into the previous branch of the same element (e.g. Mao into Yin): fading.

terms.yi: 卦里没有出现的六亲,到本宫首卦里找,伏在某一爻下面。
terms.def: A relation missing from the hexagram, looked up in the head hexagram of the palace; it lies hidden under one of the lines.

terms.yi: 伏神上面压着的那一爻。
terms.def: The visible line that sits over a hidden line.

terms.yi: 六爻里没有这一类。
terms.def: None of the six lines carries this relation.

terms.yi: 子午、丑未、寅申、卯酉、辰戌、巳亥六对相冲。冲静爻为暗动,冲空为实,冲合为开,冲衰爻为破。
terms.def: The six opposed branch pairs. A clash stirs a still line, fills a void one, opens a combination, and breaks a weak line.

terms.yi: 子丑、寅亥、卯戌、辰酉、巳申、午未六合。合住的爻被绊住,等冲开。
terms.def: The six combining branch pairs. A combined line is held; it waits to be clashed open.

terms.yi: 申子辰水、亥卯未木、寅午戌火、巳酉丑金四局,三爻合成一种五行。
terms.def: Three branches that together form one element (Shen-Zi-Chen Water, Hai-Mao-Wei Wood, Yin-Wu-Xu Fire, Si-You-Chou Metal).

terms.yi: 六爻两两相冲的卦,主散、主变。
terms.def: A hexagram whose lines clash in pairs: dispersal, change.

terms.yi: 六爻两两相合的卦,主聚、主成。
terms.def: A hexagram whose lines combine in pairs: gathering, completion.

terms.yi: 卦或爻变出与自己相冲的,主反复。
terms.def: A hexagram or line that turns into its own clash: going back and forth.

terms.yi: 下三爻。常代表自己、本地、眼前。
terms.def: The lower three lines: often oneself, home ground, the near term.

terms.yi: 上三爻。常代表对方、外地、日后。
terms.def: The upper three lines: often the other side, elsewhere, later.

terms.yi: 卦所属的八宫之一。伏神从本宫首卦里取。
terms.def: The palace (one of eight) the hexagram belongs to; hidden lines are taken from its head hexagram.

terms.yi: 六神之一,主喜庆、财帛。
terms.def: One of the six spirits: joy, gains.

terms.yi: 六神之一,主口舌、文书、消息。
terms.def: One of the six spirits: talk, quarrels, documents, news.

terms.yi: 六神之一,主迟滞、田土。
terms.def: One of the six spirits: delay, land.

terms.yi: 六神之一,主虚惊、怪异、牵缠。
terms.def: One of the six spirits: false alarms, oddities, entanglement.

terms.yi: 六神之一,主凶伤、丧病、风波。
terms.def: One of the six spirits: injury, mourning, illness, storms.

terms.yi: 六神之一,主盗贼、暗昧、欺骗。
terms.def: One of the six spirits: thieves, secrecy, deceit.

terms.yi: 神煞,主走动、远行。
terms.def: A spirit-star of travel and movement.

terms.yi: 神煞,主有人扶助;也指有权势的人。
terms.def: A spirit-star of help from above; also simply a person of rank.

terms.yi: 拿本钱做买卖。以妻财为用。
terms.def: Doing business with money put in. The Wealth line is the Subject.

terms.yi: 不出本钱,靠手艺、服务、差事、人情挣钱(九流、工匠、衙役、抽丰)。以官鬼为主顾。
terms.def: Earning without putting money in: by a trade, a service, an office or a patron. Here the Pressure line is the paying client.

terms.yi: 买卖的中间人、经纪。
terms.def: A middleman in a trade.

terms.yi: 亲友凑钱轮流取用的民间互助会。
terms.def: A rotating savings-and-credit society among relatives and friends.

terms.yi: 占财时对父母的叫法:父母克子孙,断了财源。
terms.def: What money questions call the Resource line: it controls Output and so cuts off the source of money.

terms.yi: 占财时对兄弟的叫法。注意:「劫杀」在《天玄赋》里另指一个神煞,不是兄弟,看上下文。
terms.def: What money questions call the Peer line. Note: in the Tianxuan Fu the same word names a separate spirit-star, not the Peer line.
